evidence.snippet: To bridge this gap, we propose GlobeAudio, a multilingual and multicultural benchmark designed to evaluate naturalistic audio understanding.

claire_radar.motivation: Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) integrate audio perception and language understanding within a unified framework, enabling a wide range of real-world applications.

source.title: GlobeAudio: A Multilingual Multicultural Benchmark for Naturalistic Evaluation of Large Audio-Language Models

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing benchmarks lack linguistic and cultural authenticity and acoustic realism. GlobeAudio addresses this gap for comparison of models under real-world conditions, highlighting performance differences, especially for open-source models and low-resource languages.
